question: A shopkeeper wants to give a single discount equivalent to two successive discounts of 15% and 10%. What is the single equivalent discount?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive Discount Formula = x + y − (x × y / 100)

Here x = 15 and y = 10

Equivalent Discount = 15 + 10 − (15 × 10 / 100)

Equivalent Discount = 25 − 1.5 = 23.5%

**∴ Answer = 23.5%**
